prompt: Explain what each of these C64 keys/combos does: the Commodore (C=) key, RUN/STOP, RESTORE, RUN/STOP+RESTORE together, and the function keys f1 through f8.
assertions: C= key: with SHIFT switches upper-case/graphics vs upper/lower charset (and/or color selection)
RUN/STOP + RESTORE performs a warm reset / returns to BASIC (RESTORE triggers an NMI)
Explains only f1/f3/f5/f7 are unshifted and f2/f4/f6/f8 need SHIFT
